mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.is_anonymous AS anonymous, c.created_at, c.updated_at, CASE WHEN c.is_anonymous = 1 THEN '익명' WHEN u.user_id IS NULL OR u.user_status = 'DELETED' THEN '탈퇴한 회원' ELSE u.user_name END AS author_name FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.created_at ASC
SELECT comment_id, post_id, user_id, content, is_anonymous AS anonymous, created_at, updated_at FROM comments WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (post_id, user_id, content, is_anonymous) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{anonymous})
mapper.update: UPDATE comments SET content = #{content}, is_anonymous = #{anonymous}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
UPDATE comments SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
